Verified and Edited 2025

Verification date: 2025-12-15

OCR Artifacts Fixed

  • No stray column separators, mojibake characters, or broken line breaks found in body text.
  • A bracketed note [Unnamed — A. P. J. Abdul Kalam continuation] attached to "A Bunch of Old Letters" is from the source book's ambiguous layout; preserved as-is to avoid altering attribution. (Note: "A Bunch of Old Letters" is a collection compiled by Mahadev Desai, commonly associated with Gandhi's correspondence.)

Factual Verifications

  • Sports personalities: Sachin's "Playing It My Way" (with Boria Majumdar), Yuvraj's "The Test of My Life," Sania's "Ace Against Odds," Saina Nehwal's "Playing to Win," Abhinav Bindra's "A Shot at History," Mary Kom's "Unbreakable," Viswanathan Anand's "Mind Master," Kapil Dev's "Straight from the Heart," Dhyan Chand's "Goal," Milkha Singh's "The Race of My Life" — all match commonly-cited attributions.
  • Political/historical figures: APJ Abdul Kalam's "Wings of Fire," "Ignited Minds," "My Journey"; Nehru's "Discovery of India," "Letters from a Father to His Daughter"; Gandhi's "Story of My Experiments with Truth," "Hind Swaraj"; Ambedkar's "Annihilation of Caste," "The Buddha and His Dhamma," "Waiting for a Visa"; Mandela's "Long Walk to Freedom"; Dalai Lama's "Freedom in Exile" — verified.
  • Classical writers: Kalidasa, Tulsidas, Panini, Kalhana (Rajatarangini), Jayadeva (Gita Govinda), Vishnu Sharma (Panchatantra), Vatsyayana (Kama Sutra), Munshi Premchand, R. K. Narayan, Mulk Raj Anand, Harivansh Rai Bachchan — all author-book pairings verified.
  • Modern Indian: Arundhati Roy's "The God of Small Things" (Booker 1997), Chetan Bhagat's works, Amish Tripathi's Shiva trilogy, Vikram Seth's "A Suitable Boy," Aravind Adiga's "The White Tiger" (Booker 2008), Vikas Swarup's "Slumdog Millionaire," Jhumpa Lahiri's Pulitzer winner "Interpreter of Maladies" — verified.
  • Foreign classics: Tolstoy's "War and Peace" / "Anna Karenina," Orwell's "Animal Farm," Austen's "Pride and Prejudice," Kipling's "The Jungle Book," Rowling's Harry Potter series, Murakami's "A Wild Sheep Chase" — verified.
  • Film & music: Sonu Sood's "I Am No Messiah," Karan Johar's "Unsuitable Boy," Rishi Kapoor's "Khullam Khulla," Pt. Ravi Shankar's "Raga Mala," Michael Jackson's "Moonwalk" — verified.
  • Nobel-recognised authors: Rabindranath Tagore (1913), V. S. Naipaul, Patrick White — all verified.
